summary: February brings Carnival, the last of the ski season in the north and long summer days in the south.
intro: Carnival usually falls in February or early March, from Rio and Venice to the street parades of the Caribbean. Book early if you want to be in the crowd, and plan around it if you'd rather miss it.

North of the equator it's still winter: good snow in the Alps and Scandinavia, the northern lights in the Arctic, and quiet, cheaper cities further south in Europe. In the southern hemisphere summer goes on, and the dry season holds across much of South-East Asia and Central America.
